analyze_coco_results: analyze COCO detection results and generate precision-recall error analysis plots for each class
run_coco_error_analysis_cli: run COCO error analysis CLI tool with result JSON, annotation file, and output directory arguments
generate_precision_recall_plots: generate precision-recall curve plots segmented by area groups (small, medium, large) for a detection model
generate_gt_annotation_histograms: generate ground truth annotation area histogram and per-area-group count plots for COCO dataset analysis
compute_per_class_error_analysis: compute per-class precision under superclass and all-class confusion constraints using multiprocessing
